title: Borrow and return a tool
description: The everyday path through the library: a member borrows a tool from the catalog, and a librarian takes it back at the return desk. Its steps, in order, say what each part carries out.

title: Damage and repair
description: How a damaged tool leaves lending and comes back. Its steps, in order, say what each part carries out.

title: Register a member
description:
How a new member joins the library.

1. A librarian takes the person's name and email and registers them (`POST /members`).
2. If the name is blank, the email is not an email address, or the email is already registered, the request is refused and the librarian is told why.
3. Otherwise the new member is shown with the member ID to write on their card.

title: Add a tool to the catalog
description:
How a donated or bought tool becomes available to borrow.

1. A librarian adds the tool with its name and, optionally, a description (`POST /tools`). A blank name is refused.
2. The new tool starts in good condition, and the Catalog (TL-LEND-V01) lists it as available (`GET /tools`).
